{{Top|Leg}}
A '''bush runner''' was a creature native to [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

At nights it could be seen running fast from place to place.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

Some bush runners could be tamed to some degree by the [[Sulon/Legends|Sulonese]] colonists, and kept them outside their houses attached to chains.<ref name="JK" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''
